issues.title: Deprecated root-level Go files should be deleted
issues.description: The codebase has been refactored to a 4-package architecture (cmd/, analyzer/, mcp/, internal/) but old root-level .go files still exist: analyser.go, config.go, lock.go, log.go, status.go, validator.go, watcher.go. These are dead code from the flat structure and should be removed. Only main.go should remain at root.

issues.title: --mcp-with-watcher flag not implemented
issues.description: The spec describes a flag to run MCP server alongside watcher in a single process, but this is not implemented. Currently watch and mcp are separate commands that cannot run together. This would be useful for editors that want both real-time updates and MCP queries.

issues.title: LineBuffer timeout is hardcoded to 500ms
issues.description: The LineBuffer in internal/log.go has a hardcoded 500ms timeout for flushing partial lines. The spec mentions this should be configurable but there's no mechanism to change it. For slow terminals or high-latency output, this could cause issues.

issues.title: Periodic index rebuild (Future Belongs to Future) not implemented
issues.description: The spec's Roadmap mentions 'Future Belongs to Future: Periodic index rebuild with fresh sessions for consistency.' This feature is not implemented - once the session ID is generated it's reused forever, which could lead to context drift over time.

issues.title: Session ID reuse may cause context drift
issues.description: The generateSessionID() function creates a deterministic session ID from the workDir hash. This means all analyses reuse the same kimi-agent-sdk session. While this enables context sharing, it also means the AI's understanding may drift from reality if the codebase changes significantly between sessions.

issues.title: No graceful shutdown handling in watcher
issues.description: The watcher's Run() loop exits on fsnotify errors but doesn't handle SIGINT/SIGTERM gracefully. The status might remain 'analyzing' in status.json if the process is killed during analysis.

issues.title: History log file grows unbounded
issues.description: The .memo/.history JSONL file is append-only with no rotation or size limit. For long-running watcher processes with frequent changes, this file could grow very large.

issues.title: Ignore pattern matching is simplistic
issues.description: The ignored() function in watcher.go does simple string prefix matching (strings.HasPrefix). This doesn't support full gitignore glob patterns like **/*.log or negation patterns. The comment suggests merging with .gitignore but the matching is basic.
